subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th May 2022 Time: 10:00 AM We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
